source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original browser.toml entries are partitioned once across six registered manifests, with 19, 19, 18, 21, 21 and 23 tests. DEFAULT and per-test settings plus the concatenated order remain unchanged. Each new file asks tests to stay with alphabetical neighbours; follow that local extension-test placement convention. Exact blobs show the listed test bodies did not change. This is registration/configuration evidence, not a test pass, leak repair or proof of process isolation.
title: The extensions browser manifest split preserves 121 test entries and their settings
